"};
const STORE='christmas_v4_20261122';const clean=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,ch=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[ch]));
let items=DATA.items.map(i=>({...i}));try{const saved=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORE)||'null');if(saved&&Array.isArray(saved)){for(const o of saved){const mine=items.find(x=>x.id===o.id);if(mine){for(const f of ['name','position','room','notes','x','y'])if(o[f]!==undefined)mine[f]=o[f]}}}}catch(e){}
const zones=DATA.zones;let zone=zones[0].id,photo=zones[0].photos[0],selected='',query='',page='house',edit=false;
function save(){try{localStorage.setItem(STORE,JSON.stringify(items))}catch(e){}}
function el(s){return document.getElementById(s)}
function currentZone(){return zones.find(z=>z.id===zone)}
function cnt(z){return items.filter(i=>i.zone===z&&i.counted).length}
function allMatch(i){return !query || [i.id,i.name,i.category,i.position,i.notes,i.room,zones.find(z=>z.id===i.zone)?.label].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(query)}
function showPage(p){page=p;for(const name of ['house','photos','inventory','evidence'])el('page-'+name).hidden=p!==name;document.querySelectorAll('.tabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.page===p));render()}
function goto(z,p=null,item=null){zone=z;photo=p||currentZone().photos[0];selected=item||'';showPage('photos');requestAnimationFrame(()=>el('page-photos').scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}))}
function choose(id){const i=items.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!i)return;zone=i.zone;photo=i.photo;selected=id;showPage('photos')}
function roomHTML(){return `<div class="areas">`+[
 ['Living room',zones.filter(z=>z.area==='Living room')],
 ['TV living room · wood ceiling & television',zones.filter(z=>z.area==='TV living room')],
 ['Dining / adjoining display area',zones.filter(z=>z.area==='Dining / adjoining display area')],
 ['Window / corner displays',zones.filter(z=>z.area==='Window / corner displays')],
 ['Exact room not confirmed',zones.filter(z=>z.area==='Exact room not confirmed')]
].map(([title,zs])=>`<div class="area"><h3>${clean(title)}</h3><div class="room-grid">${zs.map(z=>`<button class="room-tile" onclick="goto('${z.id}')"><b>${clean(z.label)}</b><span>${cnt(z.id)} labeled pieces · ${z.confidence} location</span></button>`).join('')}</div></div>`).join('')+'</div>'}
function renderHouse(){el('house-grid').innerHTML=roomHTML();el('house-desc').innerHTML=`The first walkthrough shows the fireplace and soft snowman displays against salmon-coloured walls. The second walkthrough shows a separate cream-wall TV living room with a wood ceiling, decorated kitchen and closet doorways, and detailed ornament rows along the wall ledge left of the TV and toward the main tree. The first walkthrough also shows the china hutch and long village sideboard in their adjoining display area. Window and unconfirmed displays are kept separate rather than assigning unverified directions or distances.`}
function render(){if(page==='house'){renderHouse();return}if(page==='photos'){renderPhotos();return}if(page==='inventory'){renderInventory();return}if(page==='evidence'){renderEvidence();return}}
function renderPhotos(){const z=currentZone();el('selected-zone').innerText=z.label;el('zone-metadata').innerHTML=`<b>House location:</b> ${clean(z.location)}<br><b>Video:</b> ${clean(z.video)} <span class="badge ${z.confidence==='unconfirmed'?'warn':''}">${z.confidence} location confidence</span><br>${clean(z.detail)}`;
 el('zone-select').value=z.id;
 el('photos-tabs').innerHTML=z.photos.map((p,n)=>`<button onclick="changePhoto('${p.replaceAll("'","\\'")}')" class="${p===photo?'active':''}">${n===0?'Primary':'Angle '+(n+1)} · ${clean(p.split('/').pop().replace('100001',''))}</button>`).join('');
 el('main-photo').src=MEDIA[photo]||'';
 const visible=items.filter(i=>i.zone===zone&&i.photo===photo&&i.counted);el('pin-layer').innerHTML=visible.map(i=>`<button type="button" class="pin ${selected===i.id?'selected':''} ${allMatch(i)?'':'hidden'}" id="pin-${i.id}" style="left:${Number(i.x)}%;top:${Number(i.y)}%" onclick="choose('${i.id}')" title="${clean(i.id+' — '+i.name)}">${clean(i.id.split('-').pop())}</button>`).join('');
 el('itemcount').textContent=cnt(zone)+' unique pieces';const list=items.filter(i=>i.zone===zone&&i.counted&&allMatch(i));el('items-list').innerHTML=list.map(i=>`<div class="item ${i.id===selected?'active':''}" onclick="choose('${i.id}')"><img loading="lazy" class="list-item-thumb" src="${THUMBS[i.id]||MEDIA[i.photo]}" alt=""><div class="item-copy"><strong>${i.id}</strong> — ${clean(i.name)}<span>${clean(i.position)} · ${clean(i.photo.split('/').pop())}</span></div></div>`).join('')||'<p>No matches in this display.</p>';
 const item=items.find(i=>i.id===selected);el('detail').innerHTML=item?`<h3>${item.id} — ${clean(item.name)}</h3><span class="badge">${clean(item.category)}</span><span class="badge">${clean(item.confidence)} photo confidence</span><p><b>Exact placement:</b> ${clean(item.position)}</p><p><b>Photo:</b> ${clean(item.photo)}</p><p><b>Position in photo:</b> x=${item.x}%, y=${item.y}%</p><p><b>Home location:</b> ${clean(item.room)} · ${clean(z.location)}</p><p>${clean(item.notes)}</p><button onclick="editItem()">Edit name / placement / notes</button>`:'<h3>Select a numbered marker</h3><p class="light">Each marker identifies a distinct decorative object. Items shown in overlapping reference photos are counted only once.</p>';
 if(edit){const image=el('photo-holder');image.onclick=e=>{if(e.target.closest('button'))return;const r=image.getBoundingClientRect();const o=items.find(x=>x.id===selected);if(!o||o.photo!==photo)return;o.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,+((e.clientX-r.left)/r.width*100).toFixed(1)));o.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,+((e.clientY-r.top)/r.height*100).toFixed(1)));save();renderPhotos()}}else el('photo-holder').onclick=null;
}
function changePhoto(p){photo=p;selected='';render()}
function editItem(){const i=items.find(x=>x.id===selected);if(!i)return;const a=prompt('Decoration label:',i.name);if(a===null)return;const b=prompt('Position within display:',i.position);if(b===null)return;const c=prompt('Additional notes:',i.notes);if(c===null)return;i.name=a.trim()||i.name;i.position=b.trim()||i.position;i.notes=c.trim();save();render()}

function renderInventory(){
 const r=items.filter(i=>i.counted&&allMatch(i));
 el('inventory-total').innerText=`${r.length} matching of ${items.filter(i=>i.counted).length} unique items. Tap an image to see that item's close-up and exact placement in the original arrangement.`;
 el('table-body').innerHTML=r.map(i=>{
   const z=zones.find(z=>z.id===i.zone), pic=THUMBS[i.id]||MEDIA[i.photo];
   return `<tr><td><button class="inventory-photo-btn" type="button" onclick="openItemPreview('${i.id}')" aria-label="View photo of ${clean(i.name)}"><img class="inventory-photo" loading="lazy" src="${pic}" alt="Photo of ${clean(i.name)}"></button></td><td><a href="#page-photos" onclick="choose('${i.id}')">${i.id}</a></td><td class="inventory-name">${clean(i.name)}<span class="subtext">${clean(i.category)}</span></td><td>${clean(z.label)}</td><td>${clean(i.position)}</td><td>${clean(z.location)}</td><td>${clean(i.confidence)} / ${clean(z.confidence)}</td></tr>`;
 }).join('');
}
function openItemPreview(id){
 const i=items.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!i)return;
 window.previewId=id;
 const z=zones.find(x=>x.id===i.zone);
 el('dialog-item-heading').textContent=i.id+' — '+i.name;
 el('dialog-item-location').textContent=z.label+' · '+z.area;
 el('dialog-item-crop').src=THUMBS[id]||MEDIA[i.photo];
 el('dialog-item-crop').alt='Close-up of '+i.name;
 el('dialog-item-full').src=MEDIA[i.photo]||'';
 el('dialog-item-src').textContent='Source photo: '+i.photo;
 el('dialog-item-pin').style.left=Number(i.x)+'%';el('dialog-item-pin').style.top=Number(i.y)+'%';
 el('dialog-item-meta').textContent='Position: '+i.position+' · Home location: '+z.location;
 const dlg=el('photo-dialog');if(!dlg.open)dlg.showModal();
}
function renderEvidence(){el('evidence-list').innerHTML=zones.map(z=>`<article class="video-card"><b>${clean(z.label)}</b><p class="tiny">${clean(z.video)}</p><p class="tiny">${clean(z.location)}</p><span class="badge ${z.confidence==='unconfirmed'?'warn':''}">${z.confidence} location</span></article>`).join('')}
function csvEscape(s){return '"'+String(s??'').replaceAll('"','""')+'"'}
function download(content,name,type){const a=document.createElement('a'),u=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([content],{type}));a.href=u;a.download=name;document.body.appendChild(a);a.click();a.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),3000)}
function exportCSV(){const names=['ID','Area','Display','Description','Category','Placement in display','Room location','Photo reference','X percent','Y percent','Location confidence','Photo confidence','Video timestamp','Notes'];const rows=[names];items.filter(i=>i.counted).forEach(i=>{const z=zones.find(z=>z.id===i.zone);rows.push([i.id,z.area,z.label,i.name,i.category,i.position,z.location,i.photo,i.x,i.y,z.confidence,i.confidence,z.video,i.notes])});download('\ufeff'+rows.map(r=>r.map(csvEscape).join(',')).join('\r\n'),'christmas_decoration_positions_edited.csv','text/csv;charset=utf-8')}
function exportJSON(){download(JSON.stringify({...DATA,items},null,2),'christmas_decoration_map_edited.json','application/json')}
el('zone-select').innerHTML=zones.map(z=>`<option value="${z.id}">${clean(z.label)}</option>`).join('');
el('zone-select').onchange=e=>{zone=e.target.value;photo=currentZone().photos[0];selected='';render()};
el('search').oninput=e=>{query=e.target.value.trim().toLowerCase();render();};
el('edit-pins').onclick=()=>{edit=!edit;el('edit-pins').textContent=edit?'Position editing ON — click photo':'Edit marker positions';render()};
el('reset-edits').onclick=()=>{if(confirm('Discard locally edited positions and labels?')){localStorage.removeItem(STORE);items=DATA.items.map(i=>({...i}));selected='';render()}};
el('csv').onclick=exportCSV;el('json').onclick=exportJSON;
showPage('house');
</script></body></html>
